Bhairavastava · verse 1 · Abhinavagupta, c. 975–1025

Veneration

From the ten-verse stotra · GRETIL edition · gate: PASS
v.1 — anuṣṭubh
bhairavanātham anāthaśaraṇyaṃ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi vande
Bhairava-Lord, refuge of the helpless — by mind become Yours, in heart I venerate. The stotra opens with the devotee's stance: total surrender of mind to Bhairava.
Pushing GEM: The devotee's "doing" is NOTICING. The affliction comes to mind; the noticing of it IS the vimarśa — and the vimarśa IS what produces the nectar. Honest limit: the text assumes the noticer; for one who can't notice, preliminary practice.
